_doc: World treks (generated by tools/trails/world_tail.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand). geo.enc: encoded polyline of lat, lon, metres.

trails.name: Cerro Chirripó
trails.why: Mount Chirripó is the highest mountain in Costa Rica, with an elevation of 3,821 meters. It is located in Chirripó National Park and is noted for its ecological wealth.

trails.name: Cerro Ventisqueros
trails.why: Cerro Ventisqueros is the second highest peak in Costa Rica.

trails.name: Cerro Urán
trails.why: Cerro Urán is one of the highest points in Costa Rica, is part of the Talamanca Range and is located within the Chirripó National Park.

trails.name: Volcán Porvenir
trails.why: Porvenir Volcano is an inactive volcano, of stratovolcano type. Located in San Carlos canton of Alajuela, 3km from the related Platanar Volcano and part of the Cordillera Central mountain range.

trails.name: Cerro Congo
trails.why: The Congo Volcano, in Spanish the Volcán Congo and also known as Congo Mountain, Cerro Congo, is an inactive volcano in Costa Rica, situated in the Cordillera Central range near the Poás Volcano and within the Poás Volcano National Park.
